summary: Phase by beta/sqrt(x): for every x in [1, max_x], |x>|0...0> -> exp(2 pi i beta/sqrt(x)) |x>|0...0> (Benchmark I, arXiv:2308.12352).

domain.derivation: n_p = 10 bits per momentum component; max_x = 3*(2^n_p - 2)^2; width = 2*n_p + 2

contract: register x is restored for every x in the domain
every scratch qubit (any qubit not in x) returns to |0> for every x and every measurement outcome
the final phase does not depend on measurement outcomes (HMR/R)
|phase(x) - beta/sqrt(x) mod 1| <= tol(x) turns for every x

phase.note: tol(x) falls with x: large x need the finest precision

cost.toffoli: mean Toffoli-like gates executed per shot
cost.rotation_t: 0.56 * log2(1/eps) + 5.3 T per fine Z_POW rotation
cost.eps: pi * min_x(tol(x) - |error(x)|) / n_rot (tolerance margin split evenly over rotations)

official_verifier.pass: exit code 0 and JSON with "status": "PASS"; on failure exit code 1 and "status": "FAIL"

sources: kmx/score.py: tolerance 2^40/sqrt(x) in units of 2^-64 turns, _score_terms
